Name: Minakie's Dressers
Author: Minakie
Description:
[i][left][s][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zXgDX0nc/about-the-mod.png[/img]﻿[/s]
[/left][/i][size=2][s]
These dressers are [b]recolors[/b] for the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/331/?]Get Dressed[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2348]Kisekae[/url]﻿ mods and you'll need one of them for my dressers to work. You can only have [b]one[/b] of these working at the time, so you'll need to choose the color you want and replace the one on the original file (GetDressed or Kisekae).
GetDressed and Kisekae broke in the 1.4 update but you can still use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4734]Customize Anywhere[/url]﻿ mod, which is a partial replacement.
[/s][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044?tab=description]Get Glam[/url] is the new replacement for those mods. Install it if you want the dressers to be functional. :)[/size]



[size=3]Minakie's dressers are now updated for Content Patcher![/size]

[size=3]This means you can now choose from two different models (floor or wall) or even have them both at the same time![/size]
[size=3](The Floor version replaces the [/size][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modern_End_Table]Modern End Table[/url][size=3] and the Wall version replaces the [/size][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/%27Dancing_Grass%27]Dancing Grass[/url][size=3] painting.)[/size]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/648/648-1575802056-223956642.png[/img][/center]﻿
[size=3]Each model comes in 11 colors: beige, birch, black, chocolate, modern, mahogany, oak, silver, vanilla (GetDressed original), walnut, and white.[/size]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/648/648-1575802142-1055025317.png[/img][/center]
[size=3]For further customization, you can also add some accessories to the Floor version or a butterfly to the Wall version.[/size]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/648/648-1575802161-122676637.png[/img][/center]

[size=3]If you have the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url][size=3] mod installed, you can use it to spawn your cutie of choice by looking up "dresser" in its search bar.[/size]


[b][u][img]https://i.postimg.cc/d0qJ6Fgb/installation.png[/img]﻿
[/u][/b]
[size=3]- Make sure you have [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][size=3] and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][size=3] installed as well[/size]
[size=3]- Download my latest file and unzip it[/size]
[size=3]- Navigate to your "[/size][i]Stardew Valley\Mods"[/i][size=3] folder and drop the extracted folder there[/size]
[size=3]- Run the game to generate the config file (just leave it as-is or tweak the options to your liking)[/size]
[size=3]- Have fun :)[/size]


[b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/sgCjB7mD/note.png[/img]﻿
[/b]
[size=3]If you want to use one of these dressers with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044?tab=description]Get Glam[/url], you'll need to navigate to [/size][i][CP] [/i][i]Minakie's Dressers\assets\dresser_floor[/i][size=3] and rename the dresser of your choosing to "[/size]dresser.png[size=3]". Then, you need to grab that renamed dresser image, drop it inside [i]GetGlam\assets[/i][/size] and let it override the existing image.


[b][u][img]https://i.postimg.cc/RFY9vHqm/special-thanks.png[/img][/u][/b]

[size=3][spoiler]Cat, Digus, LadyShardust, Lumina, Minerva, Mouse, Ria, Pathoschild, SaintPickles, Strobe, TheElm, Wingheart and all the other nice people from the #modding channel at the Stardew Discord (seriously, there's way too many to mention them all, I'm probably forgetting people).[/size]

[size=3]This was my first time attempting to code a CP mod and I wanted it to have it all (recolours, overlays, in-game names/descriptions matching the visuals) so it took [/size][i]a ton[/i][size=3] of trial-and-error but the modding community was always supportive and helped push me through my own fear of coding to make sure versions of my mods updated for 1.4 would eventually see the light of day.[/spoiler]﻿[/size]

Downloads.Description:
A Custom Furniture version of this mod, to add the dressers to the game as extra items instead of having to replace the existing end tables.
Unlike the Content Patcher version, these dressers do not include the optional decorations.
